description_en: Manually executes the remediation for a specified rule
description_zh: 手动执行指定的规则修正
name: StartRemediation

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For information about how to obtain the rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The resource ID for single-resource remediation. Example: vpc-xxx
parameters.help_zh: 单资源维度修正时指定的资源 ID，例如 vpc-xxx
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type for single-resource remediation. Example: ACS::VPC::VPC
parameters.help_zh: 单资源维度修正时指定的资源类型，例如 ACS::VPC::VPC
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource for single-resource remediation. Example: cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 单资源维度修正时指定的资源地域 ID，例如 cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: resource_region_id

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.

Data.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
